name: program-runtime.bounty-replay
purpose: Run or resume one sealed bounty replay with Agent Manager, Test Genie, durable coding-job scoring, and a code-free review packet.

case_id.description: Registered case id. Supply this or public_url; the private case-catalog owner resolves the trusted immutable bundle.

public_url.description: Exact registered public bounty URL. Supply this or case_id; arbitrary URLs are rejected by the case-catalog owner.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this case replay; reused by every Sandbox, coding-job, Agent Manager, and Test Genie create/reattach operation.

assumptions: Case intake is synthetic and authorized; source/reference roots are local public project copies, never customer data.

The registered case bundle supplies frozen evaluator and Test Genie plan material; Program Runtime constructs typed validation intents from owner-resolved seal references, and Test Genie remains authoritative for source identity and run status.

Agent Manager profile and declaration availability are owner-controlled. Missing solver workflow returns unavailable with durable job/seal state retained; this program never substitutes another workflow.
Client Rehearsal's replay_key makes coding-job creation idempotent; callers resume with the same registered case selector and idempotency_key.
invariants: The solver receives only case id, task text, and the disposable candidate checkout path; never the reference path, reference seal, evaluator, or expected answer.
All reference resolution stays in transient program state and is excluded from signals, evidence, solver input, and review packet.
Sandbox seals are verified before validation and again before coding-job score persistence; tamper or identity mismatch leaves the job resumable in scoring.
Test Genie producer receipts and durable child run identities are the only source of validation outcomes.
Returned immutable receipt evidence and derived disposition are compared against each requested variant before coding-job evaluation is mutated.
Score is derived only from the verified immutable receipt; caller case data cannot provide a score or disposition.
Optimistic revisions are read immediately before every coding-job mutation; receipt idempotency keys are stable across recovery.
Review packets contain opaque identities, job state, score, and immutable receipt references only; never source paths or code.

signals.solver_run_ref: Agent Manager execution identity, when the exact workflow starts
signals.score: closed score label derived from Test Genie immutable evidence
signals.receipt_id: immutable Test Genie FrozenReplay receipt id
signals.disposition: Test Genie qualified or not-qualified disposition
signals.tamper_detected: whether Workspace Sandbox reported a changed seal
signals.review_packet: bounded code-free packet linking case, score, job and receipt identities

outputs.evidence: owner operation identities, seal digests, validation receipt/run identities, immutable receipt digest

budget.async_reason: The exact solver may run for thirty minutes and three sealed Test Genie variants each have a twenty-minute execution budget; asynchronous submit/wait preserves the single-owner run while bounding the full sequential case at two hours.

fixtures.note: Malformed synthetic input is rejected before case-catalog, Sandbox, coding-job, solver or Test Genie calls.
